say:1:1322562001:1.text: I've been worried about how the kids would be affected by the whole Hypogean mess, but hearing that puts me at ease. As long as they're healthy, that's all that matters. They're the future of Whiteridge, after all.
say:1:1322562001:1.source_cn: 我一直担心孩子们会在这次恶魔事件中受到影响，听您这么说...

say:2:1322562002:1.text: I really appreciate you taking the time to help. I'll keep doing my best to handle the duchy's day-to-day affairs. With your help, we'll restore peace here in no time.
